description: This file contains the implementation of a cURL-based HTTP client adapter class for the Zend Framework, specifically 'Zend_Http_Client_Adapter_Curl'. It manages HTTP connections, requests, and responses using the cURL PHP extension, and implements interfaces for HTTP client adapters.

classes.name: Zend_Http_Client_Adapter_Curl
classes.description: A class providing an adapter for Zend_Http_Client based on the cURL extension, handling HTTP connections, request execution, and response retrieval.

methods.name: setConfig
methods.description: Sets the configuration options for the cURL adapter, accepting arrays or Zend_Config objects, and handles proxy settings.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the current configuration options of the adapter.

methods.name: setCurlOption
methods.description: Sets an individual cURL option for the current request.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Initializes a cURL session to the specified host and port, configuring SSL options if needed.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Executes an HTTP request with specified method, headers, body, and connects to the server, handling different HTTP methods and streaming options.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Returns the raw server response stored internally.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the cURL session and resets connection state.

methods.name: setOutputStream
methods.description: Sets a file stream for response output.

methods.name: readHeader
methods.description: Callback function for processing response headers from cURL.
